How do I put an existing non-versioned directory under Git control, and what directory gets created?
$ git init This creates a new subdirectory named .git that contains all of your necessary repository files
What counts as tracked besides files from the last snapshot?
Tracked files are files that were in the last snapshot, as well as any newly staged files
What does git add do if I give it a folder instead of a file?
if it’s a directory, the command adds all the files in that directory recursively
When reading git status --short, which column represents the index and which represents working files?
the left- hand column indicates the status of the staging area and the right-hand column indicates the status of the working tree
How can an ignore pattern make an exception for one file?
You can negate a pattern by starting it with an exclamation point (!)
What are the two equivalent options to see the staged diff?
git diff --cached to see what you’ve staged so far (--staged and --cached are synonyms)
How can I bypass the add step for already tracked changes when committing?
Adding the -a option to the git commit command makes Git automatically stage every file that is already tracked before doing the commit
How can I untrack README but leave the file on disk?
To do this, use the --cached option: $ git rm --cached README
Is git mv fundamentally different from moving a file and staging the old and new paths yourself?
git mv is one command instead of three — it’s a convenience function
Which log option shows the patch introduced by each change?
-p or --patch, which shows the difference (the patch output) introduced in each commit
Which log filters accept a lower bound for the commit date?
--since, --after Limit the commits to those made after the specified date
When I amend the latest commit, does the previous commit remain in the branch history?
You end up with a single commit — the second commit replaces the results of the first
How do I list the fetch and push URLs behind each remote nickname?
You can also specify -v, which shows you the URLs that Git has stored for the shortname to be used when reading and writing to that remote: $ git remote -v
Which git tag flag creates the annotated kind?
The easiest way is to specify -a when you run the tag command
How do I abbreviate checkout to co across my repositories?
git config --global alias.co checkout
